assets.label: Plant health
assets.review: Balanced paired lobes and centred notch/tip; geometric symmetry judged visually, not guaranteed mathematically.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished transparent pixel-art game UI icon for Pixotchi, a collectible plant garden game.
Primary request: create ONE beautifully proportioned red health HEART icon, entirely new artwork. This is a production icon, no sheet, no presentation card.
Style: authentic, clean 16-bit RPG inventory pixel art, like a carefully hand-drawn 32x32 logical-pixel sprite enlarged cleanly. Crisp square pixel clusters on one consistent grid, stepped contours, limited flat colour ramps, a dark plum-charcoal outline about one logical pixel thick. Warm, appealing, rich but restrained, suited to simple pixel NFT plants in terracotta pots. No vector appearance, smooth gradients, brush texture, anti-aliased illustration or 3D.
Critical geometry: the HEART SILHOUETTE must have exact bilateral mirror symmetry around the vertical centre axis. Equal-width equal-height rounded lobes; identical stair steps on the left and right; centred notch and bottom point. Broad pleasant upper lobes, clean taper, no drooping or smaller side. Shading may be asymmetric, geometry may not.
Colour: rich ruby and tomato-red body, darker crimson lower-right facets, small coherent coral and pale warm-pink upper-left highlight. The highlight is a restrained flat pixel cluster, not scattered dots. Approximately 7-9 colours including the near-black plum outline.
Composition: only a single heart, upright front view, centred in a square image, silhouette occupies about 72% of canvas width and 70% height. Equal transparent margins left/right. No rotation, no perspective, no drop shadow, no sparkles, no face, no outlines around a background card, no lettering.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, not black, white or a checkerboard pattern. Preserve transparency around the entire icon.

assets.label: Swordsman
assets.review: Blade, grip, crossguard midpoint and pommel share a visually coherent diagonal axis.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one finished transparent pixel-art SWORD icon for Pixotchi's plant battle UI.
Primary request: a beautiful balanced short fantasy sword, pointing diagonally from bottom-left to top-right at precisely 45 degrees. This is one production icon, not a sheet.
Style: polished 16-bit RPG inventory pixel art, hand-placed square clusters on a consistent approximately 40x40 logical pixel grid. Crisp stepped dark plum-charcoal outline, clean material colour ramps, controlled light from upper left. Matches a charming pixel NFT garden: organic green accents, warm gold and jewel-lilac weapon.
CRITICAL CONSTRUCTION: blade tip, the blade's central ridge, crossguard's exact midpoint, grip centre and pommel centre must all lie on ONE straight diagonal axis. The handle continues the blade's centreline with no sideways offset or kink. The two sides of the blade have equal width and matching contour steps about that axis. Crossguard is perpendicular to the axis and extends equally on both sides. Pommel is centred. Geometrically precise, elegant and visually balanced.
Subject: straight double-edged lilac-steel blade with a pale lavender central ridge and violet shadow edge, simple symmetrical warm-gold crossguard, short dark forest-green wrapped grip, small gold pommel. Recognisable sword proportions: blade about 64% of length, grip plus pommel about 22%, rest guard/neck. No decorative extra blades, wings, faces or attachments.
Composition: one sword only, full tip and pommel visible, centred in a square with balanced transparent margin on all sides, occupies about 76% of square diagonal. Face of weapon visible; orthographic icon, no foreshortening.
Background: genuine transparent alpha. No checkerboard, background colour, floor, shadow, text, label, frame or watermark.
Rendering: precise square pixels and flat colour clusters, no painterly texture, no bevelled 3D, no blurred gradient glow, no stray sparkle dots.
